delivery.outcome: Decompose build_context in src/koru/context.py: extract the planfile pre-flight into _planfile_is_initialised, the fetch/compatibility-repair/fixture-filter chain into _collect_ticket_state returning a _TicketState NamedTuple, and the final brief assembly into _assemble_context; make _fetch_ticket_data return a _TicketFetch NamedTuple (star-adapting _parse_ticket_response's unchanged tuple) so the decomposed body has no tuple unpacking, dropping build_context from CC=9 / fan-out=20 / mutations=23 to CC=2 / fan-out=7 / mutations=6 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while preserving the public keyword-only build_context signature, output shape and side-effect order.
nonGoals: Reducing the pre-existing complexity of _parse_ticket_response, _process_list_payload, _load_sprint_data, _promote_bug_priority or _build_policy_rules (already over threshold before this ticket, unchanged by it)
Changing merge_missing_ticket_records' tuple contract (it has other callers)

architecture.decision: Extract three cohesive phases (presence pre-flight, ticket collection, brief assembly) and return NamedTuples (_TicketFetch, _TicketState) from the fetch path so build_context and the new helpers contain no tuple unpacking, which code2llm double-counts as mutations.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the inline build_context body and the plain tuple return of _fetch_ticket_data.
